categories.main_business_segments: Krosaki Harima Corporation operates four main business segments: Refractories (manufacturing and sales of refractories for industrial furnaces), Furnace Engineering (design, construction, and repair of various furnaces), Ceramics (manufacturing and sales of industrial ceramics and landscaping materials), and Real Estate (leasing of stores and warehouses). The company also had a lime business for steelworks, which was exited as of March 2025.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies center on advanced refractory materials for steelmaking and other high-temperature industries, including high-durability, high-functionality bricks, unburned bricks, and energy-saving ceramics. Manufacturing methods include both traditional kiln-fired and innovative non-fired processes, with a focus on carbon-neutral and energy-efficient production. The company also develops proprietary installation and recycling technologies for refractories and advanced ceramics for electronics and environmental applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are steel manufacturers, with Nippon Steel accounting for over 40% of consolidated sales. Other key markets include non-ferrous metals, cement, glass, and semiconductor/electronics industries. The company also serves the construction and manufacturing sectors through its furnace and ceramics businesses.
categories.geographic_coverage: Krosaki Harima has a global footprint, with major operations in Japan, India, China, Europe (notably Spain and the Netherlands), North America, and Southeast Asia. Overseas sales account for approximately 45% of total revenue, with significant growth in India and established presence in Europe and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, supplying finished refractories, ceramics, and furnace engineering services directly to industrial end-users, especially steelmakers. It also manages some upstream activities through raw material procurement and recycling initiatives.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global expansion, especially in India and emerging markets, and strengthening the ceramics segment. R&D focuses on carbon-neutral technologies, high-performance and differentiated refractories, recycling, digital transformation (DX), and development of eco-friendly products. The company is also investing in human capital, sustainability, and digitalization to enhance productivity and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products (refractories, ceramics), engineering and construction services (furnace business), and real estate leasing. Sales are recognized upon delivery or project completion, with some contracts using progress-based revenue recognition for long-term projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Krosaki Harima is a leading global supplier of refractories, positioned as a top-tier ceramics and refractories company with strong ties to Nippon Steel. Major competitors include other global refractory manufacturers such as RHI Magnesita, Vesuvius, and Shinagawa Refractories. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, global reach, and strong customer relationships, especially in Japan and India.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached ¥177.9 billion, with recurring profit of ¥15.3 billion and net income attributable to shareholders of ¥12.5 billion. The company has shown steady growth over the past five years, with a focus on profitability and overseas expansion. Total assets are ¥187.1 billion, equity ratio is 50.8%, and the workforce numbers over 5,000 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Krosaki Harima emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and innovative refractory and ceramic solutions that support industrial productivity and sustainability. Its value proposition includes advanced, eco-friendly products (e.g., TOUGHMAX™, Dry-Free®, KROTECT®), strong technical support, and the ability to deliver integrated material and engineering solutions globally. The company’s focus on carbon neutrality, recycling, and digitalization further differentiates its offerings in the market.
